title: Chang'an Daoist monastic network
shortSummary: Daoist activity in Chang'an relied on multiple institutions, ritual services, ordination records and court connections rather than one building.
curatorialDescription: The network connects figures and city while reserving separate place and institution records for each identified site.
researchNote: Institution names, dates, urban wards and ritual functions still need sourced records.
